en: “Please, enjoy.”
“Thank you...”
“Thank you...”
“Thanks, {Me}...”
“Oh, that's good.”
I put a fresh cup of black tea in front of each of them.
Along with the tea I leave a plate of freshly baked cookies in the middle.
“These are fresh from the oven, grab 'em while they're hot.”
“Mmmmm... These cookies are delicious!”
“Absolutely! I just love sweet things.”
“Oh... I'm going to get fat.”
“Seriously... I'm jealous, y'all get to eat such amazing food everyday.”
“Just one more...”
“What's going on... How come Shizuko's here eating cookies like it's nothing?”
“Ohhhh, finally someone said it! I've been biting my tongue forever!”
“What... Can't I eat with you guys?”
“It's not that... Just that... It's a bit sudden.”
“You're quite the opponent.”
“It's only a party with lots of people.”
“I only came to check in on you all.”
“To make sure that this isn't degenerating into a den of vice.”
“Yeah, as if you weren't the one who invited {Me} around to your house last Friday?”
“Talk about being brazen.”
“Th-That was to... discuss a work report!”
“Really?”
“Yes, if you don't believe me, ask him!”
“Ugh... sorry... don't ask me.”
“Never mind.”
“From now on I'm going to be keeping this sexy man busy on the weekends.”
Shizuku suddenly comes right up to me and holds my arm in her hands.
“Ah... I thought we said this would be a fair competition...!?”
“You can't sneak off. You have to keep your word!”
Ayano also suddenly comes right up to me and holds my other arm in her hands.
Erm... I'm definitely getting some karmic payback for this in the future.
“The fair competition is between the three of us.”
“But the rules don't apply to Shizuko!”
“Wait! What does that mean!?”
“Who asked for you to drag your desperate pheromones over here anyway?!”
“Desperate pheromones...?!”
“Oh my... What is that strong odor?”
“I wasn't focused just now so I didn't notice it, but...”
“If I'm not mistaken, that's Chanea. It's the best for making your man lose his shit, isn't it?”
“I just sprayed a little... Is it that obvious...?”
“She gave herself away.”
“Ahhhh... Get lost all of you!”
Shizuko runs up to me and pushes Ayano and Shizuku off me.
Ah... I'm starting to think that all of my future good fortune is being used up right now.
“You do smell really good.”
“Hey, stop creeping...!”
“How am I supposed to not smell you... Hey, what're you doing... Don't shove tissue paper up my nose!”
“If I just stuff this up your nose, you won't be able to smell it... Hahaha!”
“I might just not be able to breathe before then anyway!”
“You were right... Shizuko's too dangerous.”
“Hmmm, he'd never fight like this with us.”
“Whatever, she's not going to be your excuse for running off. Let him go!”
“You've already stolen his first time. Why can't I just give him a little hug!?”
“Would you all just cool it already?”
“Hey... If we stuff his mouth too that shouldn't be a problem!”
“Shizuko... Calm down please!”
“I am calm!”
“Let {Me} go!”
“NO! You let him go!”
*BANG*...There's a sudden loud noise from the other side.
I come back to my senses and realize it's the cups I just put on the table.
“Can you keep it down?”
Sizuko&Ayano&Shizuku
Her tone is calm but there's something cold about it that I can't place.
That's strange... Is Kasumi that scary?
“Ah... The tea's gone cold. We should finish it.”
“Okay...”
“You too, Shizuko. No more playing.”
“And you.”
“I'm sorry...”
“Hmmm... I know that you all like {Me}, I do too.”
“But we can't let this start to cause trouble for us all.”
“I've been keeping myself composed for a long time now... I wanna do it too...”
“Eh?”
“Look... Let's put it like this, we haven't had much fun since we came back to the village.”
“So where should we all go next Sunday for some fun?”
“Like there's hot springs nearby... Or what about the beach? It would be a waste if we didn't go there during the summer!”
“Oh... That's not a bad idea. I've always wanted to go to the hot spring!”
“The beach? I don't want to go anywhere crowded...”
“But if we all went together...”
“What about Shizuko, do you want to come too?”
“Is that okay?”
“Of course. It's only fun if there's a lot of us. Besides, it's so boring here at home.”
“Hahaha, normally I only have beer for company.”
“Where would you like to go, Shizuko?”
“Erm... I really want to go to the riverbank and have a BBQ.”
“Oh... that's good!”
“Not bad at all. Let's find a time to all go together.”
“Erm... We still need to wait a week...”
“Hehe... Time flies.”
“Have dinner with us this evening, Shizuko, before you go home.”
“I... well... if you insist.”
